annotations.text:
DIRECTION A — keep Packman's own look

Your existing design system, unchanged: flat 0-radius panels, amber #E0A050, Instrument Sans / JetBrains Mono / Martian Mono.

The 21st.dev idea borrowed here is the animated beam pipeline — Installer to PSADT to .intunewin to Intune, with light travelling the completed span — plus a bento-grid dashboard.

Buildable in your current XAML. No new dependency.

DIRECTION B — rebuild on WPF UI (lepo.co)

Windows 11 Fluent: Mica backdrop, custom TitleBar, NavigationView with a selection pill, 4px/8px radii, InfoBar, CardExpander, Segoe UI Variable.

Amber kept as the accent so it still reads as Packman.

A real NuGet package you can actually install — but it replaces the design system in Themes/, not just the layout.
